text: I'm sorry if this is a lot, I'm his stepdad and his mum is on a night shift and I can't get hold of her and I'm honestly scared. He's 21 months. He's had runny poos since yesterday, 3 or 4 nappies today, but he's drinking his milk and water fine and his nappies are wet like normal so I didn't think much of it. But just now when I changed him his skin looked really odd. It's all pale and kind of mottled, like patchy, on his legs and tummy. And his lips look a bit greyish to me? Not his normal pink. I put the big light on to check and I still think they look wrong. There's no rash, I looked all over him, and there were a couple of little marks on his back but they went white straight away when I pressed a glass on them. He's awake and alert, sitting up pointing at the telly and babbling at me, and he woke up easily when I went in. So part of me thinks he's fine. But the colour of him is really freaking me out and I don't know if I'm seeing things because I'm tired. I don't want to wait if I shouldn't.
